title: Wayne S. Peterson
vital_facts: Baptized as a child; Aaronic Priesthood as a youth; Melchizedek Priesthood as a young man
Married Joan Jensen 1961, Logan Utah Temple; six children
Bishop, High Councilor, Stake President, Regional Representative
President of the California Oakland Mission 1985-1988
President of the Nauvoo Illinois Temple 2007-2010
